description: A Dart/Flutter client for planning trips, fetching stop departures, and looking up individual trips over the Spider transit API.
rules: Construct one client with your environment base URL and API key, then reach a surface: SpiderClient('https://your-env-slug.api.tiducto.eu', apiKey).routing / .stops / .realtime.
Plan a trip with client.routing.plan(PlanOptions(origin: ..., destination: ...)); get stop departures with client.routing.departures(stopId) and a single trip with client.routing.trip(tripId).
Search or geo-query stops through client.stops, and poll live vehicle positions, delays, and alerts through client.realtime.
Every call returns a SpiderResult<T> you branch on (Success / Failure); ordinary failures never throw.

Page a plan with client.routing.planNext(route) / planPrevious(route), which read route.pageInfo; RouteEdge.cursor is deprecated and always "NoCursor". A via visit takes a stop: ViaLocation.visit(Location.stop(id), minimumWaitSeconds: 0-3600).
A Failure with SpiderErrorCode.queryRetired (HTTP 410) means the API part this SDK version calls is retired; upgrade the SDK.
